newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso pares advance on last-minute dlr cover.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso pares advance on last-minute dlr cover.

text.p: The peso closed firmer on Friday but pared its earlier gains against the dollar as dealers rushed to square last-minute dollar positions prior to the close of the month, traders said.
"The market opened with dealers dumping long dollar positions, but some still needed to square month-end positions and thus bought some dollars, which weakened the peso a little," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate closed 1.5 and 0.9 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.8160/7.8210 and 7.8140/7.8180 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had earlier closed 2.2 centavos firmer at 7.8020/7.8050 per dollar.
Traders said volume for the session was thin and dealing was light.
"The session was somewhat dull, really. We saw no big trades, neither by locals not foreigners. It's Friday and people want to get away early," a trader said.

Some dealers saw support for the 48-hour peso at 7.80 per dollar at the beginning of February and a trading range of 7.81/7.84. They did, however, also predict volatility ahead of the Federal Open market Committee meeting On Feb 4.
The 48-hour peso closed the month 5.6 centavos firmer than at the end of December.
